# solidcraft (part copied unchanged)

From https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft, commit 38cecb1c6ab402be65afdf70b3ffdf2d2fe8c9cb. Licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see repo/).
Copied: its five modelling skills (skills/: modeling, editing, checking, mechanisms, sheetmetal) and its MCP documentation (docs/mcp.md) - how an AI agent models through SolidCraft's
MCP server. The application itself (Rust, ~850 MB of source) is installed from https://solidcraft.io/download (free) and
used through its own MCP server (solidcraft-cli mcp). Brand material (LICENSE-BRAND) is not copied.
